title: <run-dir>/commissaire/producer/producers/<run-id>.json
description: The producer-side admission record `contract admit` writes into --producer-dir: it carries `key_hex` (the producer's HMAC key K_producer), the pinned public key, the admitted scope, and admission status. `key_hex` is a secret held only by the producer. Shape normative here; semantics in ../keypair.md. The shipped example redacts `key_hex` — a deliberate publication redaction, not the on-disk shape.

key_hex.description: K_producer — the HMAC secret, producer custody only

pk.description: Ed25519 public key, PEM (the published governor half)
